field.name: profile_view_layout_home_custom
field.label: Custom Layout (Home)
field.description:
Supply custom substitution and content plugin supported HTML layout to display. This includes support for the following additional substitutions: [viewing] ("self" or "other"), [navigation] (renders all collected tab navigation), and [content_POSITION] (renders tab contents from a specific position)

The following positions are available: header, footer, canvas_menu, canvas_main (includes main left, main middle, and main right), canvas_background, canvas_photo, canvas_title, canvas_info, canvas_stats, main_left, main_middle, main_right, main, line_#_column_# (e.g. line_1_column_1, line_1_column_2, line_2_column_1), not_on_profile_# (e.g. not_on_profile_1, not_on_profile_2, not_on_profile_3)
